caption: A pair of yellow-tinted sunglasses is held up in front of a white wall, and the wall looks yellow through the lenses.

sa.check: A pair of sunglasses is held up in front of a wall.
The wall looks yellow through the lenses.

pc.expect: The wall looks yellow only where the lens's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The wall is yellow with the lens off; or stays white under the yellow light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the lens and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The wall changes before the lens; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The wall through the lenses is the same wall, tinted.
pc.fail: A different scene appears; or it is mirrored; or it is heavily warped by flat lenses.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The wall moves; or the lens moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second lens appears; or the wall vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The wall's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the lens changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
